description: This file is a shell script that defines tests for Git functionalities related to commit ancestry, especially focusing on the '--ancestry-path' option and related operations. It sets up test repositories, commits, merges, and verifies the output of 'git log' and 'git rev-list' commands against expected results, thereby serving as a test suite for Git's ancestry path features.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Performs a merge operation using 'git merge -s ours', tags the merge commit, and ensures the merge completes successfully.

methods.name: test_ancestry
methods.description: Runs 'git log' with specified arguments, compares the output to expected results, and validates the lineage of commits based on the provided criteria.
